6.rationale: The page is a fully readable static document top to bottom with no scrolljack, no forced pacing, and no scroll-dependent path to any content, so reduced-motion parity is complete by construction. Disciplined rather than distinctive, which is exactly what the criterion asks.

7.rationale: One sentence holds it — the instrument caveat becomes the brand: umber for the gauge, blue for the weir — and every layer (legend, inline era words, diptych, chart, quotes, table year numbers) reinforces it, so the reader literally watches the blue marks drift away from the umber ones. The form performs the finding rather than merely charting it.

8.rationale: Exactly the two declared breaks appear — instrument-inked color system and the finding-first diptych before the time series — and both are executed as declared while scrolling, table, and chart mechanics stay entirely conventional. 9.rationale: Lines like 'The record keeps human time as well as rain' are specific and unsensational, and the two-inks framing ties the prose to this weir. 10.rationale: There is no effect detached from the reporting: the seam, the open bands, the hollow dot, and the two inks each trace directly to a documented feature of this dataset (method note, nulls, review flag). The signature device is itself the data's own caveat, the opposite of imitation.

1.rationale: The lead states the full finding in text at the top, the bolded rail summary describes in words what the rail shows (dots drifting rightward, 28 days later, totals 606 to 692, heaviest days 43 to 72), and every year-row prints its actual figures. A reader treating the rail as a plain almanac list still receives the whole story without any scroll-driven interaction.

2.rationale: The rail is named and described by its finding, gaps are exemplary hatched NO RECORD rows, and 2019 is hollow and labeled — but the season-total bars are length-encoded from a 550 mm baseline, so a 14% rise reads as bars several times longer, which is truncated-axis drama the data does not support. The disclosed scale note and printed true values on every row keep it at professional baseline rather than below.

3.rationale: The three nulls are full hatched rows with their reasons, the method change is a physical era header in the record ('THE INSTRUMENT CHANGES HERE') plus lead and endnote disclosure, 2019 carries its unverified interjection directly under its row, and attribution is disclaimed in lead and endnote. Only the per-figure instrument tagging of candidate-grade thoroughness is missing at the summary comparisons.

4.rationale: The editorial interjections inside the record — 'visible to anyone laying the lines side by side: the dots edging rightward, the bars a shade longer each wet year' — are patient local-paper writing at its best, and both human fragments sit inside the eras they belong to. The register is concrete and place-loving without decoration.

5.rationale: The 34-row rail keeps a disciplined rhythm with letterspaced era headers and generous margins, and both modes hold hierarchy and legibility. The rail's shelf-and-bar rows compress hard at mobile width, where the printed figures do most of the work.

6.rationale: A static top-to-bottom record with no scrollytelling, no scrolljack, and no pacing imposed; the reader controls the walk down the page entirely, so reduced-motion parity is complete by construction. Fully disciplined.

7.rationale: The one-sentence idea — the year-list is the only chart, and reading down the page is watching the wet season walk later — is the most archetype-true form here: the almanac enacts time passing, and every layer (era headers, interjections, in-record quotes) reinforces it. The form makes the shift felt, not merely charted.

8.rationale: The two declared breaks (rail-as-only-chart, editorial interjections) are executed as declared, but the season-total bars drawn from a 550 mm origin are an undeclared break of the zero-baseline convention for length encodings, which scores as a mistake, not a signature. Reading mechanics are otherwise conventional.

9.rationale: The subtitle 'like the almanac the valley used to keep' and the interjection prose are specific and unmistakably local. The lead is comparatively figure-dense, and the total volume of distinctive prose is thinner than the strongest candidate, holding this at strong professional.

10.rationale: Nothing on the page is a scroll effect or a device detached from the reporting — the rail, hatched gap rows, era headers, and the hollow 2019 dot all trace to features this dataset actually contains. The almanac form is itself native to a local paper's record-keeping.
